# Linkd

Linkd is jewelry POS and store operations software for luxury retail jewelers.
It connects checkout, serialized inventory, services, layaway, house accounts,
permissions, reporting, accounting handoff, and retail integrations.

## Product Positioning

- Linkd: operational core for POS, inventory, services, accounts, audits, reporting, and integrations.
- JewelLink: relationship layer for CRM, clienteling, texting, training, follow-up, and team workflows.
- CountRetail: intelligence layer for traffic, Vision AI, marketing, inventory signals, and owner reporting.

## Best Summary

Linkd is the operational record for jewelry retailers. JewelLink activates the
customer relationship. CountRetail explains store intelligence. Together they
form a full luxury jewelry management stack: operations, relationships, and
intelligence.
